paper_title: Thionated PDI supramolecular polymers: controlling aggregation mechanisms, morphology and function

knowledge_points.content: Thionation of the PDI1 monomer is achieved using Lawesson's reagent in anhydrous toluene, producing a mixture of products with one to six oxygen-to-sulfur substitutions (PDI1-S1 to PDI1-S5).
knowledge_points.evidence: Thionation of PDI1 was achieved by reaction of the parent PDI with Lawesson's reagent (LR) in anhydrous toluene... products containing between one and four sulphur atoms were isolated... termed PDI1-S1 to PDI1-S4.

knowledge_points.content: Thionation of the PDI core results in a bathochromic shift of approximately 50 nm in the absorbance maximum for each successive substitution, while side-chain amide thionation has minimal impact on the absorbance spectrum.
knowledge_points.evidence: PDI1-S1 and PDI1-S2 exhibit spectra almost identical to the parent PDI... PDI1-S3 displayed a maximum absorbance at 580 nm, whereas both S4-substituted PDIs exhibited identical maxima at 622 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Core thionation of PDI derivatives leads to the complete quenching of fluorescence due to facilitated inter-system crossing to a longer-lived triplet excited state.
knowledge_points.evidence: The typically strong fluorescence of PDI materials is completely quenched in all derivatives exhibiting any degree of core thionation... attributed to a reordering of electronic states upon thionation, such that inter-system crossing to a triplet excited state is facilitated.

knowledge_points.content: Thionation induces a transition in the self-assembly mechanism of PDI supramolecular polymers from a highly cooperative model (for PDI1, S1, and S2) to an isodesmic model (for S3 and S4).
knowledge_points.evidence: Overall, a clear transition from a highly cooperative polymerisation process to one that proceeds isodesmically is evident upon successive oxygen-to-sulphur substitutions.

knowledge_points.content: The thionated derivative cisPDI1-S4 exhibits higher conductivity and a greater electrostatic field compared to the parent PDI1, as measured by PeakForce tunnelling AFM (PF-TUNA) and electrostatic force microscopy (EFM).
knowledge_points.evidence: cisPDI1-S4 exhibits a greater degree of conductivity than that of parent PDI1... greater electrostatic field, for thionated cisPDI1-S4 compared with the parent PDI1.

knowledge_points.content: The enthalpy change during elongation (ΔHe) for PDI1 assembly is -137.8 kJ/mol, which decreases in magnitude to -45.1 kJ/mol for PDI1-S1 and -22.6 kJ/mol for PDI1-S2 due to weakened hydrogen bonding.
knowledge_points.evidence: enthalpic change during elongation, from -137.8 kJ mol-1 for PDI1 to -45.1 and -22.6 kJ mol-1 for PDI1-S1 and PDI1-S2, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) reveals that cisPDI1-S4 assembles into well-dispersed nanofibers with a mean width of 8.5 nm, whereas transPDI1-S4 forms wider ribbon-like structures with a mean width of 70.4 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: cisPDI1-S4 assembles into individual, well-dispersed supramolecular fibers... mean of 8.5 nm... transPDI1-S4... Typical widths of these ribbon-like structures were between 30 and 200 nm... mean value of 70.4 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Lateral aggregation in thionated PDI nanofibers is promoted by additional S-S and S-π interactions, which are particularly effective in the transPDI1-S4 isomer where sulfur atoms are exposed on opposite edges of the PDI core.
knowledge_points.evidence: Additional S-S and S-π interactions should encourage this type of lateral aggregation on the sulphur-substituted edges... In transPDI1-S4, sulphur atoms are positioned on opposite edges... leading to the formation of wider structures.

knowledge_points.content: Methylcyclohexane (MCH) is used as a selective solvent to induce self-assembly in PDI1 and its thionated analogues, allowing for the observation of distinct morphological transitions as the degree of thionation increases.
knowledge_points.evidence: the solution self-assembly of all obtained derivatives was investigated in methylcyclohexane (MCH). This solvent has previously been demonstrated to strongly induce aggregation in PDI1.

knowledge_points.content: The degree of polymerization at 293 K drops from >10,000 for the parent PDI1 to significantly lower values (between 3 and 7) for core-thionated derivatives PDI1-S3 and PDI1-S4 due to the shift to an isodesmic mechanism.
knowledge_points.evidence: At 293 K, a degree of polymerisation > 10 000 was determined for PDI1... PDI1-S3 displayed a degree of polymerisation of 3.5, cisPDI1-S4 a value of 3.2, and transPDI1-S4 a value of 7.0.
